Haihaya
------------------------------------------
Haihaya is the name of an ancient dynasty with its capital at माहिष्मती. The most celebrated ruler of this dynasty was कार्तवीर्यार्जुन (also known as अर्जुन) who had ‘one thousand arms’.
The southern Malwa region of Madhya Pradesh has been identified as the ancient माहिष्मती city.
See also KĀRTAVĪRYĀRJUNA.
